interpretation.coordinate_metric_sq: Local weight placed on a unit physical amplitude error by flat MSE in the standardized transform coordinate: (f'(a)/std(f))^2.
interpretation.inverse_jacobian_sq: Physical amplitude error caused by a unit standardized-coordinate error: (std(f)/f'(a))^2. This is the radial factor entering a Cartesian endpoint loss before its residual term.
interpretation.support_probability: Probability that a standard-Gaussian decoder state lies below the exact inverse transform's physical lower bound.
